regions.full_page: God bless you and yours. I hope this finds you continuing in good health and hopes and that things are brightening their smiles in your direction. I am surely pleased to know of John and Marian doing better and sailing along more smoothly with their nice little family. Thanks be to God for the grace to do so. I started to write them away last winter - both of them - but was mostly in bed for a couple of months and that took quite a little pep out of me, so that for several long weeks I was able to do very little. I started to write Dorothy and Charles D'Amico too a number of times as well as yourself but I just do not know where the time flies to. We are sending an enrollment card for deceased Thomas Patrick La Plante to his poor, bereaved parents as directed. Now as to that primary problem of your own. I am not at all surprised that as time slips by and wounds of social bereavements heal, God's laws in common life as well as in the supernatural should seek to adjust their claims. I have no doubt but that our dear Lord and His blessed Virgin Mother has provided a remedy where-by to fully supply what He permitted for a time to be with- drawn from your social and family existence, - a sweet mother- love, a dear father-love, a devoted husband-love. Only just keep on praying for God's merciful guidance - for self and associates - and in His divine wisdom God will not fail you in His guidance for the best.
